# Gil Cleber Barboza — projects

> Portfolio hub for projects by Gil Cleber Barboza (software architect,
> Sorocaba, Brazil). Oracle & PL/SQL developer tools, plus Python and Rust
> building blocks. Site: https://thepaneb.github.io/

## Projects

- Hub (all projects): https://thepaneb.github.io/
- utPLSQL Test Runner — VS Code extension for Oracle PL/SQL tests (documentation site): https://thepaneb.github.io/vscode-utplsql/
- isis-report-lib — Python library for tabular PDF reports (documentation site: standards, ASVS, roadmap, API, pt-BR quickstart): https://thepaneb.github.io/isis-report-lib/
- isis_report — async microservice for PDF reports (Robyn): https://thepaneb.github.io/isis-report/
- Samsung Remote — desktop & Android remote for Samsung (Tizen) TVs: https://thepaneb.github.io/samsung-remote/
- My Tuya Home — local-first dashboard for Tuya/SmartLife plugs: https://thepaneb.github.io/my-tuya-home/
- paneb-videogen — Android app + API for short AI videos: https://thepaneb.github.io/paneb-videogen/
- base_flask — Flask Dev Container template: https://thepaneb.github.io/base-flask/
- base_robyn — Robyn Dev Container template: https://thepaneb.github.io/base-robyn/

## Source

- GitHub: https://github.com/thepaneb
